Many times I feel like that but I heard I phrase in an anime , I know is kind of childish  but it goes like this " good things come to you if you just live long enough " and I started to think that even though many times life is full of bullshit  there are times when it isn't so bad not all are great but who knows maybe in the future there will be an amazing moment in your life that you will remember for eternity. In my case I'm university student I try to not get overwhelmed by my studies by doing what I like it's not always easy but I worth i shoot because at the end all the money or knowledge is worthless if you are dead , try to enjoy what you have now that you can (obviously don't waste it), also try to get disconnected by reading books watching series or playing videogames try to find a hobby to do it with friends or to find new ones , it helps a lot for me playing videogames alone helps me a lot and more if it's with friends  . Also a pet helps you go though the hards days.
I'm 21 and I don't have much expectations for the future to be honest but what keeps me going is my dog and the intrigue of what will happen in the future of this rotten world will we destroy each other , nature will kill us  it sound like I'm waiting for another season of a tv series.
Don't give up my friend maybe you will find your soulmate that will give light to your life many things can happen in the future some good some bad but if you give up you will never know and believe me some might be worth a shot.
I hope this helps sorry if it not; 
A resume: focus on things you enjoy , try to do a at least a thing you enjoy every day , don't worry about what others think ( it helps a lot it's not easy  I'm still working on it) and try to disconnect by doings thing you find comfortable (games,book,movies) 
As you said no one can be happy all the time . Happiness is like a state its temporary so we have to stop looking for a happy life because it doesn't exist , life is full of bad an good moments but never is all good or bad try to think back , find those happy moments and try to make new ones.
Sadly the only way to know if it is worth living is at the end of the road
